headline: Maersk confirms breach as WhiteArmor demands $5M; critical Zoom Workplace flaw; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12, Barracuda ESG 11-13

bullets.text: New: Maersk confirmed a data breach; the WhiteArmor ransomware group is demanding $5 million (BleepingComputer). Earlier today it was probing an IT incident and data theft.
New: a critical Zoom Workplace flaw, CVE-2026-108186, could allow unauthenticated remote privilege escalation (The Hacker News). Zoom has released patches (SecurityWeek).

Critical Xen Orchestra flaws are exploited in attacks (3 outlets; no CVEs or fixed releases in the brief). Qlik Sense servers are hit with reverse shells while attackers stage ActiveMQ and Veeam exploits.

KEV due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited on Linux, 3 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779, IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218. Due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560, Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935.

Breaches today: a $26 million cyber heist hit a small New Jersey town; York University (19 years of student data), Credit Mutuel Arkea (€100m missing), Fullerton Health, Wyndham and hundreds of Dutch sports clubs also reported incidents.

Still active: N-able hotfixes for the published N-central zero-days (5 outlets); Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave exploited (KEV due 11-24); AntiFox AI agents used to steal AWS credentials. Week ran 1.15x the 90-day average.

actions: Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure and Citrix.
Update Zoom Workplace clients and servers for CVE-2026-108186.
Inventory Xen Orchestra instances and keep them off the internet; check Qlik Sense servers for reverse shells and patch ActiveMQ and Veeam.
N-central customers: apply the hotfixes. Patch Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave Webtop, Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) and Chrome before 11-24.
Review AWS access keys and CloudTrail for unusual use, rotate exposed credentials, and update Git on developer machines and CI.
